_why: The floor CI holds the shipped retriever to. Retrieval is deterministic - two runs two days apart produced byte-identical numbers - so these are exact values, not estimates, and any drop is a real regression rather than noise. Raise them deliberately when a change earns it; never lower them to make a build pass.
_configuration: hybrid dense+BM25, fusion depth 20, rrf_k 5, weights [1.0, 0.3], k=5, 34 answerable questions
_precision: Written to three decimals, and compared at three decimals. With 34 questions the smallest possible change in any of these is 1/34 = 0.029, so rounding cannot hide a regression.
